description:
C-2 PROVENANCE archive from operating-disciplines.md §8.1 (Positive references only), Arc 47 op-disc debloat cut (stoa--xyb.8). The verbose empirical-anchor prose, archived FIRST then deleted inline (replaced with Anchor: stoa--xyb.8.<this-id> in the slim core).

Empirical anchor: 2026-05-04 — a project-tier install paste said "Run `bw prime` in this directory (NOT user-beadwork)." The "NOT user-beadwork" parenthetical seeded awareness of user-tier bw into a project-tier session that wouldn't otherwise have known it existed. PRINCIPAL caught and corrected before the activated session reached for the wrong store.

This is the N=1 anchor for the §8.1 positive-references-only discipline: reference only POSITIVE resources the agent should use; never reference resources they shouldn't reach for, even with NOT/EXCEPT qualifiers — because a negative qualifier mentions the resource as a real thing, defeating bounded-context properties, and the downstream agent under pressure rationalizes the now-known thing as a legitimate exception. The §8.1 RULE + anti-pattern/discipline table stay inline in the slim core; only this empirical-anchor story relocates here.
